name: Inma Inkan ~Shokushu to Gattai Shite Omoidoori ni Yarikaesu~
original_name: 淫魔淫姦～触手と合体して思い通りにやり返す～
source:
Murakami Yasuharu is a subject of bullying.

Getting ignored, being treated harshly, for so long, he had endured, but they gradually escalated. However, there is no one around him to rely on, and eventually, his spirit is cornered, and exhausted. In the midst of his despair, looking for an easy way to end his life, he comes across a website about demon summoning. As he reads through the article, "If you want to kill yourself, then take revenge," and with that sentence, he decides to give it a try. Although he is skeptical, he gathers the materials needed for the summoning, at the cost of his own soul, he tries to summon the demon.

However, a mysterious monster appears. Panicked, Yasuharu runs out of his house, and gets into an accident, before losing his life instead of his soul, the creature that he has summoned──the monster merges with him, keeping him alive.

Thus, now merged with the monster and even acquired a special power, Yasuharu begins to take revenge on the person who bullies him.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274293]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
村上康晴是欺凌对象。

被忽视、被粗暴对待，他已经忍受了这么久，但这些情况逐渐升级。然而，他的身边却没有人可以依靠，他的精神最终被逼入绝境，疲惫不堪。在绝望之中，他正在寻找一种简单的方法来结束自己的生命，他偶然发现了一个关于召唤恶魔的网站。当他读完这篇文章时，“如果你想自杀，那就报仇。”随着这句话，他决定尝试一下。尽管他心存疑虑，但他还是收集了召唤所需的材料，以自己的灵魂为代价，尝试着召唤恶魔。

然而，神秘的怪物出现了。惊慌失措的泰晴跑出了家门，遭遇了一场事故，但他并没有失去灵魂，而是失去了生命，而他召唤的生物——怪物与他融合在一起，让他活了下来。

于是，现在与怪物融合，甚至获得了特殊的力量，安晴开始向欺负他的人报仇。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274293]Getchu[/url]]
